test_append_ones: test the append_ones static method that prepends a column of ones to tensors of any dimension
test_linear_regression_training: test the LinearRegression model by training on random features and verifying loss decreases over batches
test_state_dict: test the state_dict and load_state_dict methods to save and restore LinearRegression model parameters
test_coefficient_recovery: test that LinearRegression recovers ground truth coefficients when trained on synthetic data with noise
test_zero_features_zero_coefficients: test that coefficients for always-zero features remain near zero during and after training
